name: Shokushu Ningen ~Nurse no Itoko Hen~
original_name: 触手人間 ～ナースの従姉妹編～
source:
Once every 97 years, the Tentacle Tree bears fruit. 
One man ate that fruit to see if the legend was true. 
Its transformative powers made him a human monster. 
You are the hero! You are... Tentacleman! 

This time you've gotten it in your head to stealthily 
receive an examination from your sexy, beautiful cousin 
who is a nurse at the central clinic. 

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng-touch/work/=/product_id/RE063646.html]DLsite English[/url]]
